Out-of-scope uses: declining an application without an officer's review
scoring applications for any other support programme
ranking applicants against each other for a fixed budget
Caveats: Trained on officers' historical decisions, not reviewed outcomes. Known biases: measurement bias in self-employed income, historical bias against family-home applicants, labelling bias in one office, evaluation bias in the original validation, and a feedback loop through auto-declines. Rates for groups with fewer than 30 eligible applicants are not estimated.
